info.name: Excledge RRA / EBM API
info.description: RRA-connected endpoints only — fiscal sales, master data, stock, purchases, imports, CIS reports.

item.name: CIS software version label (printed on receipts)
EBM enablement and VSDC online status

request.description: Blocked by `vsdcOnlineGuard` if VSDC has been unreachable beyond the offline limit. Queues `/trnsSales/saveSales` (NS/TS). Proforma (`isProforma=true`) skips fiscalization. Roles: ADMIN, SELLER, ACCOUNTANT, BRANCH_MANAGER.

item.name: Refund a sale (full refund; EBM salesSttsCd=05)

request.description: Uses `rfdRsnCd` from code class 32 (default `06`). Partial refunds are rejected.
Returns 202 while outbox processing is still pending.
Fields: TIN, VRN, vatRegistered, ebmDeviceId, ebmSerialNo, trainingMode (§16 TS/TR vs NS/NR).

item.name: ERP payment method → RRA code mappings (class 07)
Sync codes, item classes, and notices
Confirm or reject a B2B purchase (§71)

request.description: `action` is `approve` or `reject` (other values treated as approve).
PRODUCT/RAW_MATERIAL require valid `itemClsCd`. Roles: ADMIN, ACCOUNTANT, SELLER, BRANCH_MANAGER.

item.name: Update product (re-queues RRA item sync when fiscal fields change)
Create production run (ledger → pending stock sync)
Create customer (TIN present → async RRA customer sync)
